entries.en: to run with the current; to go downstream.
to run; running (at a run).
entries.notes: H栏前二字『抽抽』疑为记音而非本字，义由『走』与西语词头 id corriendo 定。

entries.zh: 跑开不答理；径自离去、问而不答。
entries.en: to run off and give no answer; to bolt away without replying.
entries.notes: 同前条，H栏前二字为记音；『去』补足『跑掉』之义。

entries.zh: 走马楼；沿屋架设的有顶外廊。
entries.en: covered open gallery running along a building (zouma-lou); veranda corridor.

entries.zh: 『满方』：成方形的廊道（与上条同类，西语栏残损难解）。
entries.en: a square gallery (same type as the preceding; the Spanish text is corrupt).
entries.notes: L栏 con otra dida alacara 不成句，H栏原注存疑，仅『方』义可定。

entries.zh: 同前条；『接方』指相接的廊。
entries.en: same as the preceding; a connecting gallery.
entries.notes: L栏括注示其为上条附条，M栏明写 idem。

entries.zh: 行家：商行、同业老手；代理商人。
entries.en: expert, old hand; (merchant) house or firm; broker.
entries.notes: cantia 疑为 cuantía（规模、地位），故『大行家』；此条『corredor』当取经纪人义。

entries.en: courier; letter-carrier.
a runner who carries news; news-runner.
a despatch submitted to a mandarin; official document.
entries.notes: 西语作『官的信差』，汉栏落在一纸呈文上，名实略有出入。

entries.en: post-station runner; foot courier of the relay post.
to deliver documents; document-carrier.
express despatch; news of victory sent post-haste.
the King's envoy; imperial commissioner.

entries.zh: 承差：衙署中承办公差的差役。
entries.en: yamen runner who undertakes official errands.
tender, soft, young.
entries.notes: 西语栏 Corresta cota 显有讹夺，然 H/M/R 三栏一致指『嫩』。

entries.zh: 嫩（疑为『嫩』之讹写）：柔嫩、软弱。
entries.en: tender, soft (character uncertain, probably 嫩).
entries.notes: H栏原注『疑:姺/嫩』，而 M、R 皆作 nūn，仍当是『嫩』。

entries.zh: 熊（释义存疑：汉字与音写、西语栏互不相合）。
entries.en: bear (identification uncertain).
entries.notes: 西语 Correo la cota 与 H『熊』、M guiām 三者不能互证，暂存字面。

entries.zh: 应：回应、报答；朋友间往来相应。
entries.en: to respond, to requite; to correspond (between friends).
to back up; to reinforce; to answer with aid.
to match up, tally; to agree with each other.
